extension.description: Fast viewer for Markdown, PDF, HTML and LaTeX files. Built for Remote-SSH, works on macOS, Windows and Linux.
capabilities.untrusted: Compile mode and workspace-defined settings are disabled in untrusted workspaces.
setting.fastDocViewer.followPanel.autoOp: Open the viewer automatically when you open a supported file.

Open the viewer automatically when you open a Markdown file. The viewer reuses one panel, so switching files is fast. Easiest way to set everything up: run **Fast Document Viewer: Turn On All Viewers** from the Command Palette.
setting.fastDocViewer.followPanel.replac: Show the viewer instead of the text tab.
Show the viewer in place of the text tab, so each file has one tab. Needed for PDF, HTML and LaTeX. Use the **Edit as text** button to see the source.
setting.fastDocViewer.pdf.enabled.md: View `.pdf` files in the viewer. Needs `#fastDocViewer.followPanel.replaceTextTab#` and the editor association `"*.pdf": "default"`.
setting.fastDocViewer.html.enabled.md: View `.html` and `.htm` files in the viewer. Needs `#fastDocViewer.followPanel.replaceTextTab#`. Scripts in the page run, but the network is blocked and the page can only read its own folder. The page reloads when you save the file.
setting.fastDocViewer.tex.enabled.md: View `.tex` files in the viewer. Needs `#fastDocViewer.followPanel.replaceTextTab#`. By default this is a quick HTML preview that needs no TeX install. See `#fastDocViewer.tex.mode#` for a real PDF.
setting.tex.mode.html: Quick HTML preview, no TeX needed.
setting.tex.mode.compile: Real PDF built with latexmk. Needs TeX installed locally.
setting.fastDocViewer.tex.mode.desc: How .tex files are shown: html preview or compile with latexmk.
setting.fastDocViewer.tex.mode.md: How `.tex` files are shown. `html`: a quick preview with no TeX install. `compile`: builds the real PDF with `latexmk` on your own computer and recompiles when you save. Compile mode runs your TeX project, so it is off in untrusted workspaces.
setting.fastDocViewer.tex.texPath.desc: Folder with latexmk. Empty means auto-detect.
setting.fastDocViewer.tex.texPath.md: Folder that contains `latexmk` and the TeX engines. Leave empty to auto-detect: macOS looks in `/Library/TeX/texbin`, Linux uses the standard `PATH` (for example `/usr/bin` after `apt install texlive`), Windows uses the `PATH` set by MiKTeX or TeX Live. Set it only if TeX is installed somewhere unusual. This setting is only read from your user settings.
setting.fastDocViewer.tex.maxMirrorMB.de: Size limit for the local copy used in compile mode.
setting.fastDocViewer.tex.maxMirrorMB.md: Compile mode builds in a local copy of your project (TeX-related files only). It stops and reports if the copy would be larger than this many MB.
Allow images from https links in documents.
Allow images from `https:` links in your documents. Turn this off to block remote images, so opening a file never contacts another server.
setting.fastDocViewer.customCss.desc: Extra CSS added after the built-in style.
setting.fastDocViewer.customCss.md: Extra CSS added after the built-in page style, for example to change fonts. This setting is only read from your user settings.

walkthrough.compile.title: Optional: real LaTeX PDF
walkthrough.compile.desc:
Compile mode builds the real PDF with latexmk. Needs TeX installed.
[Read the LaTeX guide](https://github.com/toqitahamid/fast-document-viewer/blob/main/docs/latex.md)
setting.fastDocViewer.theme.desc: Page style: always paper, or follow a dark editor theme.
setting.fastDocViewer.theme.md: Page style. `paper` always shows the light printed-paper page. `auto` shows a dark page when your editor theme is dark. High-contrast themes always get a high-contrast page.
